cards.name: Model Gateway
cards.hint: OpenAI-compatible proxy (LiteLLM). Routes inference to llama.cpp.
cards.notes: User-facing Open link = the LiteLLM Swagger UI, which must be served from an origin ROOT (root-absolute asset paths) — hence the `llm` subdomain, not a /llm/ subpath. See services_catalog.model_gateway_open_url().
